# radtrax

> Descriptive statistics, smoothing filters and composable transforms for one-dimensional numeric series, with zero runtime dependencies. Batch statistics (`summarize`, `quantile`, `zscores`) and a streaming accumulator (`RunningStats`); moving-average, median and exponential smoothing with explicit boundary padding; and fit / apply transforms (`Standardize`, `MinMaxScale`, `Clip`, `MovingAverage`) that compose into a `Pipeline`, plus a `radtrax` command-line tool. It is the worked example of the radtrax project template. Use these instead of hand-writing statistics loops, rolling windows, validators and scalers.

One package, `radtrax` (import `radtrax as mp`), installed from GitHub: `uv add "radtrax @ git+https://github.com/jejjohnson/radtrax.git"`. Before writing a helper, search the capability index — every public name with a one-line summary. Code you add should keep three rules:

- **Inputs are never mutated:** no function changes the series it is given, and any sequence of numbers is accepted; the series-to-series functions and every `apply` return a new list.
- **Fit, then apply:** `Standardize` and `MinMaxScale` learn from `fit(train)` (which returns the transform) and raise `NotFittedError` if applied before it; reuse the fitted object on new data.
- **Transforms are structural:** anything with `apply(series) -> list[float]` is a `Transform` and composes in a `Pipeline`, with no base class; bad input raises `ValidationError` (a `ValueError`), and every error is a `RadtraxError`.

Claude Code users can install the `radtrax` plugin: `/plugin marketplace add jejjohnson/radtrax`, then `/plugin install radtrax@radtrax`.

## Start here

- [Home](https://jejjohnson.github.io/radtrax/): what the package does, the three layers, its design rules
- [Quickstart](https://jejjohnson.github.io/radtrax/quickstart/): every feature in five minutes
- [Capability index](https://jejjohnson.github.io/radtrax/reference/capabilities/): every public name, grouped by module, with a summary
- [Building with agents](https://jejjohnson.github.io/radtrax/agents/): the Claude Code plugin, this file, and rules to paste into your project's AGENTS.md
- [Guided tour](https://jejjohnson.github.io/radtrax/tour/): the whole public API on one dataset

## Guides

- [Statistics](https://jejjohnson.github.io/radtrax/statistics/): batch and streaming statistics, `ddof`, numerical stability
- [Smoothing](https://jejjohnson.github.io/radtrax/smoothing/): the three filters and the padding strategies
- [Transforms](https://jejjohnson.github.io/radtrax/transforms/): the fit / apply lifecycle, pipelines, writing your own transform
- [Command-line interface](https://jejjohnson.github.io/radtrax/cli/): `radtrax summarize` and `radtrax smooth`, exit codes

## API reference

- [Overview](https://jejjohnson.github.io/radtrax/reference/)
- [Statistics](https://jejjohnson.github.io/radtrax/reference/stats/): `summarize`, `Summary`, `quantile`, `zscores`, `RunningStats`
- [Smoothing](https://jejjohnson.github.io/radtrax/reference/smoothing/): `moving_average`, `exponential_moving_average`, `median_filter`, `Padding`
- [Transforms](https://jejjohnson.github.io/radtrax/reference/transforms/): `Standardize`, `MinMaxScale`, `Clip`, `MovingAverage`, `Pipeline`, `chain`
- [Utilities](https://jejjohnson.github.io/radtrax/reference/utils/): validators, `Window`, `timer`
- [Protocols](https://jejjohnson.github.io/radtrax/reference/typing/): `Series`, `Transform`, `Fittable`
- [Exceptions](https://jejjohnson.github.io/radtrax/reference/exceptions/): `RadtraxError` and its subclasses
- [CLI](https://jejjohnson.github.io/radtrax/reference/cli/): `main`, `build_parser`
